name: Flipmode
editorial_article:
"FLIPMODE" is a collaborative EP released in 2025 by the Paris-based electronic producers OOGO (Ugo De Angelis) and Aksel Aksel (Aksel Bahouche). Released on the prominent French label Nowadays Records, the project serves as a dynamic synthesis of their distinct musical backgrounds, merging OOGO's technical precision—honed through his work with the collective La Fine Équipe—with the raw, rhythmic instinct brought by Aksel Bahouche. Across five tracks, the EP navigates a borderless landscape of club music, drawing heavily from the frameworks of bass music, footwork, Afrobeat, and house.

The project is characterized by a balance between high-energy club utility and deep, introspective sound design. Tracks like "SACÙDETE" and "SKANK LOW" illustrate this duality, moving between spiritual, driving rhythms and heavy, hypnotic low-end tension. The EP also features a vocal collaboration with Bright Edem Kwesi Addo on "HWAN NA," further cementing the project's interest in integrating global club textures into a contemporary European electronic framework. "FLIPMODE" is presented not merely as a collection of dance floor records but as a sensory exploration of movement, designed to resonate simultaneously in the physical space of a club and the internal landscape of the listener. By blending organic warmth with sharp electronic production, OOGO and Aksel Aksel establish a collaborative identity that is both fresh and deeply rooted in the current evolving state of modern club culture.
